destination.name: Wuxi
destination.tagline: Canal streets, gardens and Lake Tai shore halfway between Shanghai and Nanjing
destination.description: Wuxi is a canal city roughly halfway between Shanghai and Nanjing, with more than 3,000 years of history. Lake Tai lies to its south and the Yangtze to its north, and the Grand Canal runs through the centre. Visitors come for the lake shore, from the Lingshan Grand Buddha to Turtle Head Island, and for old canal-side streets around Huishan and Qingming Bridge. Suzhou is under half an hour away by bus or car.
whyVisit: Wander old canal streets and gardens
See cherry and plum blossoms in spring

goodToKnow.title: Metro reaches the old town
goodToKnow.detail: Line 4 stops at Huishan Ancient Town and Line 1 at Qingming Bridge, so the canal districts are easy without a car.

goodToKnow.title: Museum closed Mondays
goodToKnow.detail: Wuxi Museum is free to enter but closed on Mondays, and entry stops an hour before closing, so go Tuesday to Sunday.

goodToKnow.title: Summer is hot and wet
goodToKnow.detail: June is the rainiest month and July highs reach 33 °C, so spring and autumn are better for walking.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Cherry blossoms and mild autumns suit best, as summers are hot and wet. Aim for {months}.
